name: accountable
description: Accountable, a sales CRM that runs on your own computer

scripts.dev: npm run db:deploy -w backend && concurrently --kill-others --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w backend && playwright test
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
